errors.text: The hypothesis substitutes a W-Ni-Fe-Ta refractory alloy for the target Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic high-entropy alloy.
It replaces the defining 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h HPHT intervention with rolling, annealing, and aging, so it does not reconstruct the target processing strategy.

The proposed precipitate-shearing and order-hardening mechanism does not capture the target hierarchical FCC/B2 transformation, cross-phase dislocation transfer, or convergence of phase-resolved GND densities.
